zh: key-encapsulation mechanism (KEM)：双方经公开信道建立同一共享秘密密钥的一套算法。
ML-KEM：FIPS 203 对由 CRYSTALS-KYBER 派生之 KEM 所定的正式名，基于 Module-LWE 假设。
Module Learning With Errors (MLWE)：ML-KEM 安全性所归约的格上困难问题。
K-PKE：ML-KEM 底层的组件明文公钥加密方案，标准禁止其独立使用（shall not）。
Fujisaki-Okamoto (FO) transform：把 K-PKE 转换为具备 IND-CCA2 安全性的 KEM 的变换。
parameter set (512/768/1024)：ML-KEM 在强度与性能之间给出的三档实例化选择。
en: Key-encapsulation mechanism (KEM): a set of algorithms by which two parties establish one shared secret key over a public channel.
ML-KEM: the formal name FIPS 203 gives to the KEM derived from CRYSTALS-KYBER, built on the Module-LWE assumption.
Module Learning With Errors (MLWE): the lattice problem to which ML-KEM's security is related.
K-PKE: the component public-key encryption scheme under ML-KEM, which the standard bans from stand-alone use (shall not).
Fujisaki-Okamoto (FO) transform: the conversion that lifts K-PKE into an IND-CCA2-secure KEM.
Parameter set (512/768/1024): ML-KEM's three instantiations trading security strength against performance.
